# HoBo CI error catalog

A `hobo ci` command that stops prints a code with its message; with `--json` the code is the
`code` field. Codes are stable: a code's meaning does not change, and a new failure gets a new
code. A few codes report an outcome rather than a failure, and their message says so. The
runner order these codes guard is described in
[ADR-0183](../design/adr/runner-order.md#adr-0183).

This page is generated from the source, so it lists every code the code returns and nothing
else. Text in braces, such as `{repository}`, is filled in when the command runs. A code whose
message is composed when the command runs shows no message here; read the command's output.

Agents reach this page through the `hobo-ci` skill (`.claude/skills/hobo-ci/`, mirrored in
`.agents/skills/`), beside `hobo-ci-route-jobs` and `hobo-ci-insights`. The one-page setup guide
for an agent starting from nothing is [`site/public/ci/setup.md`](../../site/public/ci/setup.md).

## Codes

### HOBO_CI_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-command.ts`.

Messages:

```text
The CI credential selects a different account than the saved link. Reconnect with an explicit --relay and --repo.
```

```text
The installation response does not match the selected CI account. Check the relay before retrying setup.
```

What to do: follow the message.

### HOBO_CI_ADOPTED

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-relay-adopt.ts`.

Message:

```text
Adopted Vercel's deployment of {repository}@{sha}: {found.url}
  Freight {promoted.report.alias} promoted through {promoted.report.pipeline}: preview {preview.report.state} (deployment record READY), production {promoted.report.state} ({production.origin} serves {…} and is ready)
  deployment {found.deploymentId}{…}; nothing was deployed or changed on Vercel
```

What to do: follow the message.

### HOBO_CI_ADOPT_AUTH_REQUIRED

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-relay-adopt.ts`.

Message:

```text
--adopt reads GitHub's Deployments API with the token env://GITHUB_TOKEN names (in a workflow, GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }} with deployments: read). No Vercel token is read.
```

What to do: follow the message.

### HOBO_CI_ADOPT_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-relay-adopt.ts`.

Messages:

```text
The adopt deadline {…} leaves less than {…} for the lookup, preview and production, so nothing was read or recorded. Re-run the workflow, or give a later --deadline or a larger --budget.
```

```text
{…}
  Nothing was changed on Vercel{…}. The next push to main, or a re-run of this commit (hobo ci deploy --adopt --sha {found.commit}), adopts it.
```

What to do: follow the message.

### HOBO_CI_ADOPT_LOOKUP_FAILED

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-relay-adopt.ts`.

Message:

```text
GitHub's Deployments API could not be read ({why}). Nothing was recorded; the job needs deployments: read.
```

What to do: follow the message.

### HOBO_CI_ADOPT_NOT_ADOPTED

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-relay-adopt.ts`.

Message:

```text
The Freight being realized pins {…}, not the adopted deployment of {found.commit}; --adopt never creates a deployment.
```

What to do: follow the message.

```text
Vercel reported no production deployment of {project} for {repository}@{sha} within the lookup's share of the adopt budget (until {…}). Nothing was recorded; the next push or a re-run of this commit looks again.
```

### HOBO_CI_ADOPT_ORIGIN_UNSET

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-relay-adopt.ts`.

Message:

```text
--adopt verifies production at the relay's production domain, and none is named: set HOBO_CI_RELAY_URL or the productionOrigin property of Yard {relayYard.name} (an https origin, e.g. https://<project>.vercel.app). The per-deployment URL is not probed: Deployment Protection answers 401 there.
```

What to do: follow the message.

### HOBO_CI_APP_CONVERSION_UNCERTAIN

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-app-create.ts`.

Message:

```text
GitHub's manifest conversion failed or its answer could not be read. The App may exist: check https://github.com/settings/apps, delete an App HoBo did not finish, and run the command again.
```

What to do: follow the message.

### HOBO_CI_APP_DEPOSIT_FAILED

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-app-create.ts`.

Message:

```text
GitHub App {slug} (id {appId}) was created, but its credentials could not all be stored in Infisical ({lastCode}). Stored: {…}. The rest were held only in memory and are now discarded; GitHub's manifest conversion cannot be repeated. Delete the App at {deleteUrl}, fix Infisical access, and run hobo ci app create again.
```

What to do: follow the message.

### HOBO_CI_APP_EXISTS

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-app-create.ts`.

Message:

```text
The config service already holds {…}. Pass --yes to replace them with a new App's credentials.
```

What to do: follow the message.

### HOBO_CI_APP_HANDOFF_FAILED

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-app-create.ts`.

Message:

```text
GitHub created the App's one-time code, but `gh workflow run relay-deploy.yml` did not start. The code expires within an hour; check `gh auth status`, then delete the App GitHub may have created (https://github.com/settings/apps) and run the command again.
```

What to do: follow the message.

### HOBO_CI_APP_HOST_UNSUPPORTED_OWNER

Returned from `packages/hobo-ci/src/prepare.ts`.

Message:

```text
App host {configuredHost} is not configured or implemented.
```

What to do:

- Use HOBO_CI_APP_HOST=manifest, or unset HOBO_CI_APP_HOST.

### HOBO_CI_APP_TIMEOUT

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-app-create.ts`.

Message:

```text
GitHub did not return to this machine in time. No App was created by HoBo; run the command again.
```

What to do: follow the message.

### HOBO_CI_APP_UNVERIFIED

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-app-create.ts`.

Message:

```text
GitHub App {slug} (id {appId}) was created but does not match the reviewed configuration (owner {ownerId}, relay {relay}); its credentials were not stored and are now discarded. Delete it at {deleteUrl}.
```

What to do: follow the message.

### HOBO_CI_DEPLOY_RELAY_NOT_READY

Returned from `packages/hobo/src/ci-relay-verify.ts`.

Messages:

```text
{origin}/readyz says the relay's config service refused its identity
```

```text
{origin}/readyz says the relay's config service did not answer
```

```text
{origin}/readyz says the relay did not start
```

```text

```

```text
{origin}/healthz answered {findings.healthStatus}
```

What to do:

- The relay identity named in deploy/secret-store.binding.json must trust this project's Vercel production OIDC tokens (OIDC Auth; packages/ci-vercel/CONFIG-SERVICE.md). hobo ci secret-store verify checks the deploy identity by name.
- Check the store's status; the relay retries on every request, so re-run this workflow once it answers.
- Read the deployment's runtime log (hobo_ci_relay_init_failed names the stage).
- cache: the cache binding (deploy/yard.ts) is not reachable; executionHost: the Sandbox execution host is not configured; configService: the store stopped answering. packages/ci-vercel/README.md lists each.
- The production domain is behind protection: under Standard Deployment Protection it is public, so the origin named is not this project's production domain, or the project protects all deployments. Name the production domain, or set the project's protection to Standard.
- The production domain does not serve the relay; check the project's domains on Vercel.
